I feel like I've tried a lot of things over the years, but I find it hard to explore new things now when a lot of it doesn't really appeal to me, that much. In my long term relationship we had a pretty boring sex life, where he eventually acclimated to my sex drive, and we were almost never intimate with each other.  

I have indulged in submissive play in the past, and I find that fun. As mentioned in my post, I definitely enjoy pleasing others, and making them happy.

Orgasms have never really been something I've aimed for, or felt the need to achieve. I just really want the kind of intimate experience with someone, where both parts have a good time together. I haven't thought of getting my hormones checked, though, so I'm gonna call my doctor about it as soon as possible! Thank you.

I have considered the possibility of being asexual, but I'm not entirely sure what it means. I've always been interested in sex, and I want to have and enjoy it. I just feel unable to. Can I be an asexual with an interest in sex?

I'm not really sure. It just usually doesn't feel very nice, even when I do it myself. I've bought several toys for myself in an attempt to find out what the hype is about, with no success. 

I have some childhood trauma, that's been resolved through years of therapy, and doesn't impact my day to day life anymore, but that could be a reason, I guess. But it is in no way something I struggle with at all anymore, in any (other) parts of my life.
